title: Into the River
description: A diver plunges into the Jialing River in Chongqing, China, one of the world’s largest cities. Recently, photographer Aleksey Kondratyev came across a group of men mostly age 50 and older along the riverfront. They gather almost daily, diving and swimming during Chongqing’s famously hot summers—and, for the most dedicated, throughout the winter as well.
translated_description: 一名跳水者跃入中国重庆的嘉陵江，这是世界上最大的城市之一。最近，摄影师阿列克谢·孔德拉季耶夫在江边遇到了一群大多50岁及以上的男性。他们几乎每天都聚在一起，在重庆著名的炎热夏季里跳水和游泳——而对于最执着的人来说，整个冬天也是如此。
